summary: Iteration 1: backend (8/8 pytest passed) and Expo web UI (phone 390x844 and tablet 1280x800) tested. Translation through Claude Haiku works: Turkish output, cache hit on repeat (cached=true, ~0ms), 400 on whitespace-only text, glossary names and speaker labels kept, history returned without _id. Pipeline works: translate, then the same line is skipped ('Aynı altyazı, atlandı'), noise is filtered ('Filtrelendi: Harf oranı düşük'), the clear delay of 1.2s empties the text and sends payload {"text":""}, clear-translation works, and when two lines are sent quickly the newer one wins. The offline engine shows a native-build error. Connect tab: IP validation, add/remove console, PSN ID saved to secure storage (stays after reload), and all native buttons show the honest native-build warning. Settings: chips, engine options, steppers, toggles and reset work and stay after reload. The OCR region presets and steppers update the preview. MAIN BUG: on phone width the column wrappers use flex:1 inside the ScrollView. This makes sections overlap on the Çeviri and Bağlantı tabs and leaves a large empty gap on Ayarlar. Deprecated API detected: expo-router/unstable-native-tabs.

minor.issue: Empty string "" returns 422 (raw English pydantic detail) and only whitespace returns 400 'Boş metin çevrilemez.'. Text over 600 chars also returns 422 with a JSON-stringified detail that the UI shows to the user as-is.

A cached repeat still inserts a new history row, so history fills with duplicates (e.g. the same line shown twice, '0 ms · önbellek'). An aborted (stale) client request still finishes on the server and is saved to history.
The LLM call has no timeout. If it hangs, the UI stays on 'Çevriliyor' until a new subtitle arrives.
@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI. Use a lifespan handler instead.

ui_bugs.issue: The column wrappers <View style={{flex:1}}> are always applied, even when !wide, inside the KeyboardAwareScrollView content. On phone their height is limited to an equal flex share and content overflows. On Çeviri the 'Son altyazılar' header and the clear-history-button overlap the 'Hattı test et' card. With empty history the history-empty card covers the manual input card (wrapper 950px, content 1028px). On Bağlantı the 'TV BAĞLANTISI' section overlaps the register-console-button (839px vs 1070px). On Ayarlar there is a ~200px empty gap after the glossary and the second column overflows (894 vs 1075). Fix: use style={wide ? {flex:1} : undefined}. Refs: app/(tabs)/translate.tsx:35,94; app/(tabs)/connect.tsx:99,176; app/(tabs)/settings.tsx:39

An invalid TV IP (e.g. 'abc') is shown as an error but is still saved to settings by update({tvIp}) before validation. It stays after reload and would be passed to startTvServer. Ref: app/(tabs)/connect.tsx:196

The last translation latency (e.g. '· 601 ms') is still appended to unrelated events ('Aynı altyazı, atlandı', 'Filtrelendi', 'Altyazı kayboldu, TV temizlendi'). This is misleading. Ref: translate.tsx:53

If the engine returns an empty translation (OCR noise), the app shows '—' but sendToTv is skipped, so the TV keeps showing the previous subtitle. Send {"text":""} in that case. Ref: src/pipeline/PipelineProvider.tsx:100

On web, expo-network returns the PUBLIC IP (35.193.209.116, 'Ağ: UNKNOWN'), so ws-url-text shows an address the TV cannot reach. This is preview-only, but it should say it cannot be read in the web preview instead of showing a wrong IP.

issues: Button labels are cut off: 'Altyazı kayb...', 'Sunucuyu b...', 'Bağlantıyı t...'. Shorten the labels or stack the buttons vertically on narrow screens.
clear-history-button deletes ALL history with no confirmation dialog.
clear-history-button height is 40px, below the 44px touch target. Same for remove-console (40px), refresh-ip-button (36px) and the stepper buttons (40x40, although hitSlop 6 helps).
Header content is aligned at x=16 while the body has a maxWidth and is centered (x=56), so the left edges do not line up.

react_native_issues.issue: Metro warns: '`expo-router/unstable-native-tabs` is deprecated. Use `expo-router/native-tabs` instead.' Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:3

action_items: HIGH: Fix the phone layout overlap. Apply flex:1 to the column wrappers only when wide (translate.tsx:35,94, connect.tsx:99,176, settings.tsx:39).
Migrate the import in app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx from 'expo-router/unstable-native-tabs' to 'expo-router/native-tabs'.
Do not save an invalid tvIp to settings. Validate first, or keep a local draft and save only valid or empty values.
Show latency in pipeline-last-event only for translation events.
When the translation is empty, send {"text":""} to the TV.
Backend: skip the history insert for cached repeats (or dedupe), add a timeout around the LLM call, and return a Turkish 400 for an empty string (min_length=0 plus a manual check) and for long text.
Add a confirmation dialog to clear-history-button. Raise small touch targets to 44px. Fix cut-off button labels on phone.
critical_code_review_comments: The same {flex:1} wrapper pattern in 3 screens causes the layout bugs. Consider a shared ResponsiveColumns component.
The translation call in the frontend has no fetch timeout. AbortController is used only for newer-wins cancellation.
DELETE /api/history is an unfiltered delete_many. That is acceptable for personal use, but there is no per-item delete, so test data cannot be cleaned up selectively.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all requested flows work functionally; phone layout overlap bug on 3 tabs)

seed_data_creation: Test translations added history rows (texts starting 'TEST ' or 'Where is the hidden key, my friend?'). There is no per-id delete endpoint, so they were NOT removed. Test console and PSN ID were stored only in the ephemeral Playwright browser storage; the console was removed and settings were reset.
context_for_next_testing_agent: DELETE /api/history and clear-history-button were NOT run against real data (bulk delete). The UI wiring was checked with a Playwright route mock: the button sends DELETE /api/history, refetches history and shows history-empty. The real bulk delete needs a manual check. Run the backend tests with: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=... pytest tests/test_translate_api.py -n 0 (pytest.ini adds xdist). Frontend env key is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Expo restarted once during testing (502 on bundle) and recovered after ~25s.
rca_of_issue: Phone overlap: in the non-wide branch, `current`/`historyView` (and the ps5/tv and settings column Views) keep style {flex:1} inside the ScrollView contentContainer. On react-native-web this gives flex-basis 0 plus flex-shrink, so each column gets an equal share of the content height and taller content overflows into the next sibling. Measured overflows: translate 950->1028px, connect 839->1070px, settings 894->1075px.
